copilot-traffic-paths.title: Three Copilot network paths
copilot-traffic-paths.description: Client egress crosses the corporate proxy, browser streaming uses WebSockets to a Web PubSub host, and agent egress passes the agent firewall.

network-ownership-map.title: Who owns each network control
network-ownership-map.description: A matrix of five Copilot network controls with where each is configured and a recommended owning team.

build-client-allowlist.title: Build a client allowlist
build-client-allowlist.description: Query the meta API, add the apex host, Copilot reference hosts and editor hosts, then test a real client before approving.

websockets-data-residency.title: Stream a cloud session through a proxy
websockets-data-residency.description: The browser opens a WebSocket to the documented Web PubSub host, the proxy relays both directions, and a retry confirms streaming beyond the 101 upgrade.

proxy-configuration.title: How Copilot picks a proxy
proxy-configuration.description: Copilot checks four proxy variables in order, uses the first one found for HTTP and HTTPS, needs an http proxy URL and authenticates with Basic or Kerberos.

tls-inspection-certificates.title: Certificate trust for inspected traffic
tls-inspection-certificates.description: The Copilot client validates TLS with system stores and NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS, so an inspecting proxy works only when its root is trusted.

subscription-routing.title: Plan endpoints and network rules
subscription-routing.description: A matrix of githubcopilot.com patterns, the plans they serve and the network rule a company would apply.

routing-change-plan.title: Routing change timeline
routing-change-plan.description: Five steps from inventory to ongoing review, with the enterprise pattern allowed before any billing change and a piloted block.

firewall-settings-hierarchy.title: Firewall settings from organization to session
firewall-settings-hierarchy.description: Organization firewall settings are inherited or locked, repository rules combine with organization entries, and new sessions use the result.

firewall-coverage-limits.title: What the agent firewall covers
firewall-coverage-limits.description: A matrix of agent traffic sources, whether the firewall covers each and a compensating control for each gap.

private-runner-networking.title: Choose where the agent runs
private-runner-networking.description: Cloud sandboxes use the agent firewall; Actions sessions can use standard, Azure private networking or self-hosted runners that need explicit egress.

connectivity-troubleshooting.title: Connectivity triage loop
connectivity-troubleshooting.description: Test the endpoints, classify the error, collect redacted evidence and fix one control before retesting.
